notes: Texture reuse is prototype-friendly; final distinct family textures may be requested after in-engine review.
particle_count is a budget hint; graphics low reduces cosmetic count only.
All animation is runtime code/particles; source PNGs are single static images.

recipes.name: Large ship kill
recipes.recipe: 2 offset cards max; fragments+smoke; bright-core fade first

recipes.name: Boss armor break
recipes.recipe: localize to armor plate; inward/outward shard directions from joint normal

recipes.name: Fuel chain blast
recipes.recipe: delayed neighboring flame cards; separate deterministic capped damage events

recipes.name: Missile impact
recipes.recipe: single fast card; no giant black smoke; missile light trails code-generated

recipes.name: Ion impact
recipes.recipe: fast branching card; fade outer glow; hostile tint pass separate

recipes.name: Chain lightning
recipes.recipe: extract visual motif only; procedural jagged edge connects actual source/target

recipes.name: EMP ring
recipes.recipe: add procedural expanding ring; no repeated full-screen flash

recipes.name: Shield hit
recipes.recipe: rotate impact lobe toward incoming projectile; no collider from glow

recipes.name: Shield pickup
recipes.recipe: stable transparent ring settles around player then fades to HUD buff

recipes.name: Plasma shot
recipes.recipe: orient along travel tangent; head collision only; separate curved trail

recipes.name: Plasma impact
recipes.recipe: reuse small cropped motif candidate after review; do not flash entire projectile card

recipes.name: Joint sever
recipes.recipe: gold procedural sparks and metal chips; avoid flames covering intact loot

recipes.name: Tractor lock
recipes.recipe: thin cyan code cable + traveling motes; alpha motif scaled very small

recipes.name: Overdrive ignition
recipes.recipe: orange engine-tinted small energy motifs; code thruster cones; no damage area

recipes.name: Power-up collect
recipes.recipe: small colored ring and icon burst; choose tint by pickup role

recipes.name: Fusion assemble
recipes.recipe: 2 procedural orbit rings converge on host weapon; local purple/cyan glow

recipes.name: Dash wake
recipes.recipe: narrow cyan afterimage trail from actual path; no collision length change
